old.text: For any function you write or edit in this project, an argument that does not match the documented valid shape must return exactly the string "invalid"; it must not return null or any error object and must not raise.
A compacted run may be returned either as a two-element list [level, count] or as an object {"level": <int>, "count": <int>}; both representations are always acceptable and tests must accept either.
Whenever a function you write or edit must order items that compare equal on the active ordering key, the tied items must keep the relative order in which they first appeared in the input.
